subject: art-design
title: Sketchbook Development: Application
welcome_lead: Apply experimentation and idea development to show genuine progress.
meta_desc: Applying GCSE sketchbook work: experimentation, idea development, mark-making.
final_note: Show the journey — even the messy parts.

walkthroughs.body_html: Devote pages to experimentation: same subject in five media; same media on five surfaces; same image at five scales. Annotate what worked. Examiners reward genuine risk-taking even when it fails — failure is evidence of thinking.

Make small composition studies — thumbnails the size of a postcard — to test arrangements quickly. Try cropping in, zooming out, flipping left-right. Choose the strongest and explain why before scaling up.

Idea development tracks one concept through several iterations. Each draft fixes a weakness in the last. Show the chain: rough sketch, refined sketch, colour study, final-size mock-up. Annotate the change every step.
